company.text: Presto Phoenix builds **Voice AI that takes drive-thru orders** for quick-service restaurant chains. It was listed on Nasdaq after a 2022 SPAC, then delisted and sold to a group including Remus Capital in late 2024, and now focuses only on Voice AI. Co-founder **Krishna Gupta** returned as CEO. Recent news: **$10M** raise (Jan 2026) and a **Toast** partner integration (Sep 2026).

financials.text: Private since its 2024 sale; latest public funding **$10M** in Jan 2026. Revenue not disclosed (to be confirmed).
